CharacterStyleRange.Content: 8. Investments accounted for using the Equity Method
At the beginning of the financial period
At the end of the financial period

(i) Significant influence is derived over Racing Australia Ltd through the Board’s appointment of a nominee director and the exercise of a veto. Pursuant to a shareholder agreement the consolidated entity has the right to cast 35% of the votes at a shareholder meeting.
(ii) The consolidated entity holds a 73.25% interest in 3UZ Pty Ltd.
3UZ Pty Ltd has the power to exercise with and only with the authority of a director resolution passed by a majority:

• For a special resolution, this means a resolution of directors passed by a majority that together holds more than 50% of the total voting rights and consists of member representation from at least two code members, or

• For a super special resolution, this means a resolution of directors passed by a majority that together holds more than 50% of the total voting rights and consists of member representation from all three code members.

Therefore, whilst significant influence over the acquired entity exists, the Racing Victoria Group does not have the necessary control for it to form part of the consolidated financial statements and therefore the investment is required to be equity accounted for under AASB 10.

(iii) 3UZ Pty Ltd net assets for the reporting year include an impairment to the carrying value of its radio licences. The revised fair value was determined utilising the sale price of these assets following a post reporting year transaction (refer note 23 subsequent events).
